title: Spex Machina Project
description: Schema for the project-level spec file (project.json). Defines project metadata, top-level requirements, and module declarations with inter-module dependencies. IDs are 12-character hex identity hashes.

modules.description: Module declarations. Each module has its own directory with a module.json.

sections.description: Project-level sections with typed envelopes and freeform content.

spec_version.description: The spec format version this project speaks. Optional; absent means version 1. Lives in project.json only — module files carry no version field.

requirement.$comment: Project-level requirement. module.schema.json's copy carries preq_id in place of priority and derivation, since a module requirement derives by construction through its required preq_id. IDs are 12-char hex identity hashes computed by schema.IdentityHash.

id.description: Identity hash ID (12-char hex), unique within the requirements array.

priority.description: Requirement priority (0-4). Optional; enforced by validator when present.

depends_on.description: Identity hashes of other requirements this one depends on (depends_on edge).

derivation.description: Declares a requirement not yet derived into any module. Project-scoped only: a module requirement derives by construction through its required preq_id.

path.description: Relative path to the module directory containing module.json.

requires_module.description: Identity hashes of other modules this one depends on (requires_module edge).
